contradictions.a_quote: My car was in the shop all that week. Transmission was shot. It sat on the lift at the shop from Monday on.
contradictions.b_quote: I towed Mr. Webb's blue sedan out of the shop on Friday, October 11, and took it to his house. He said he needed it for the weekend.
contradictions.innocent_alternative: Webb may have misremembered which week his vehicle was towed home.

contradictions.a_quote: Like I said in October, the car was at the shop. It was up on the lift with the transmission out. I didn't have wheels that weekend, which is part of why I stayed in.
contradictions.b_quote:
Date: Friday, October 11, 2019
Pickup time: 4:52 PM
Pickup location: Delgado Auto Body, 1140 Fifth Avenue
Vehicle: 2014 Ford Taurus, blue sedan
Registered owner: Marcus Webb
Drop-off location: Webb residence, 412 78th Street
contradictions.innocent_alternative: The tow yard record could contain a clerical date error, or Webb misremembered the date of the tow.

contradictions.a_quote: We pushed it onto the flatbed. It wasn't driveable, but he wanted it home.
contradictions.b_quote: There was a blue sedan parked on the street in front of the shop that night. It looked like the one Mr. Webb drives. I can't swear it was his, but it was the same kind of car.
contradictions.innocent_alternative: The blue sedan seen by Vasquez on Sunday night was a different vehicle of a similar make and color, or Webb's car was repaired between Friday afternoon and Sunday night.

contradictions.a_quote:
When did you last see Mr. Delgado?
A: Friday afternoon at the shop.
contradictions.b_quote: Oct 12 — M — buyout talk again Tues. He wants numbers I don't have.
contradictions.innocent_alternative: The Saturday October 12 buyout talk could have happened by phone rather than in person, or 'M' refers to someone other than Marcus Webb.

contradictions.a_quote:
Did Mr. Delgado owe you money personally?
A: The shop owed suppliers. Ray and I were square.
contradictions.b_quote: Oct 10 — M.W. owes shop 14,200 all in. Settle by Nov or it comes out of his share.
contradictions.innocent_alternative: Webb may have distinguished between owing the shop and owing Delgado personally, or considered the balance already offset by his equity share.

contradictions.a_quote:
Did Mr. Webb take money out of the shop that fall?
A: Not that I ever saw in the books.
contradictions.b_quote: Oct 5 — M.W. took 1,900 from register for "supplier run." No receipt yet.
contradictions.innocent_alternative: Delgado recorded the withdrawal in his personal paper ledger rather than the formal accounting books maintained by Whitfield.

contradictions.a_quote: I left the shop Friday at five o'clock and I did not come back until Monday morning. I was home all weekend.
contradictions.b_quote: I did stop by the shop that Sunday afternoon, briefly, to drop off invoices. I had my key. I was there maybe twenty minutes, in the front office, not Ray's office.
contradictions.innocent_alternative: Whitfield initially forgot or omitted the brief routine errand because it did not seem relevant to discovering the body on Monday.

contradictions.a_quote: No. I wasn't at the shop that weekend at all. Like I said last year, I left Friday and came back Monday and found him.
contradictions.b_quote: I did stop by the shop that Sunday afternoon, briefly, to drop off invoices. I had my key. I was there maybe twenty minutes, in the front office, not Ray's office.
contradictions.innocent_alternative: Whitfield overlooked the brief Sunday afternoon invoice drop-off during earlier questioning focused on the crime and shop accounts.

contradictions.a_quote: Two shell casings were observed on the office floor near the desk.
contradictions.b_quote: 7. One (1) spent shell casing, brass, recovered office floor.
contradictions.innocent_alternative: Patrol officer Brennan miscounted or mistook debris for a second casing at the scene, or there is a clerical error in the evidence ledger.

reasons.quote: Home. I was home alone Sunday night. I never left the house. I watched television and went to bed early.
I've told you all of it. I was home that Sunday night, alone, the whole night. Nothing has changed.
There was a blue sedan parked on the street in front of the shop that night. It looked like the one Mr. Webb drives. I can't swear it was his, but it was the same kind of car.
